name: spec-agent
description: A small, model-agnostic coding agent built on the Vercel AI SDK, benchmarked on replicate-lang

scripts.build:
esbuild src/cli.ts --bundle --platform=node --target=node20 --format=esm --outfile=dist/spec-agent.mjs --banner:js="#!/usr/bin/env node
import { createRequire as __cr } from 'module'; const require = __cr(import.meta.url);"
